violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut lettuce and shredded mozzarella cheese delivered this morning was on the shelf near the office at room temperature was 54º and 62º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The PIC placed the lettuce and cheese in the refrigerator to cool.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Cleaning chemicals such as sanitizer and Pantastic were stored over food equipment such as aluminum foil, pan covers and pop-up foil in the storage room. Also, a bottle of hand sanitizer was stored on the prep table where quesadillas were being made.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC corrected this during the inspection by moving the chemicals to another shelf. The EHS explained to the PIC that hand sanitizer should not be stored in that location and should not be necessary in the kitchen. Employees should be washing their hands, not using hand sanitizer. The PIC moved the hand sanitizer during the inspection to correct.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: the handle for the ice scoop in the ice maker was stored in contact with the ice.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The EHS moved the ice scoop so the handle was out of the ice during the inspection.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Outside Receptacle, Tight Fitting Lids
violations.observation: Outside refuse container sliding doors were left open.
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered with tight fitting lids or doors if kept outside the food establishment. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. SHREVEWOOD ELEMENTARY SCHOOL (Inspection Date: 09/02/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Inspect Premises
violations.observation: The premises is not being routinely inspected for the presence of insects, rodents and pests. Observed evidence (droppings next to the glue board) of a mouse present in the storage room and in the managers office.
violations.corrective_action: Insects, rodents and pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Please routinely inspect the premises to control the presence of insects, rodents and pests on the premises

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed mouse droppings on the floor in the dry storage room.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean the floor in the dry storage room as soon as possible or within 90 days and keep it clean.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: two of three dressing squeeze bottles were unlabeled on the serving line at the self-service area. A spray bottle with clear liquid in it was not labeled. This bottle contained water for spraying the pretzels after reheating so the salt would stick to them.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. The manager labeled the squeeze bottles during the inspection. The manager labeled the spray bottle during the inspection.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. The splitter installed on the mop sink is the incorrect type. The current splitter does not coincide with the backflow preventor currently installed on the fixture and is not designed for systems under constant pressure. The correct type would be a Hydro Systems 1951 Pressure Bleed Dual Valve.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. The manager disconnected the unapproved splitter and will submit a work order to have the appropriate splitter installed.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed mouse droppings on the floor in the manager’s office, behind the ice machine in the kitchen, and in the dry storage room.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. The floors must be cleaned and kept clean. The manager has submitted work orders for pest control and bait stations have been installed. Please clean the floors as soon as possible.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: fried plantain (65F), cooked chicken wing (85-87F), chicken nuggets (91F), in 1 dr upright warmer.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC placed all items in the oven to be reheated to 165F.
